name: vista
prompt: A night street seen from the side, in flat simple shapes. On the left, a two-storey concrete shop building: upstairs a dim room behind a long window with bare bulbs, a dead tree and hanging vines; downstairs a wide shop window glowing amber, full of old radios, speakers and an oscilloscope, a door on its right, an old gold-leaf sign reading РЕМОНТ РАДИО above it, and a faded vertical sign reading ОТЕЛЬ on the corner; a man asleep on the step under the window. In the middle, a street lamp throwing a cone of light through the smog, and a row of bollards along a flat pavement. Behind, an elevated industrial walkway, dark smokestacks and refinery towers in thick amber-brown smog, a huge faded poster of a stern man with the word ПОРЯДОК, a pale moon. On the right, a rusty street machine with pipes and one round orange eye, and a wire-thin woman kneeling at it with her wrist locked in its cradle. Along the bottom, a wet street with long vertical reflections of the lights. Rain.
concierge: The Concierge's version of the same street, in the same flat simple shapes: upstairs a warm red-orange bar with globe lamps, lush plants and a pink neon ring; the shop window glowing gold with neat radios and speakers, the sign reading RADIO REPAIR in glowing gold leaf, the corner sign reading ホテル in red neon; the step empty. The lamp sleek, planters with lush plants. Behind, a glittering city of violet, blue, pink and cyan neon towers, a sleek train on the viaduct, and on a tall billboard the vast calm face of the Concierge in soft violet light. On the right, a sleek dark dining machine with a glowing blue ring and the words Good evening. Dinner is served., and a woman in a red evening dress kneeling at it, dining. Along the bottom, a glossy street mirroring the neon.
framing: A wide cinematic side view at street level: a standing adult is about a fifth of the image height. A row of bollards along a flat pavement at about five sixths of the image height, and below it a wet street across the whole width. Lit at night by its own lights. People appear only where the prompt places them. No border, no caption.
